abstract: The Open NAND Flash Interface (ONFI) specification defines a standardized NAND Flash device interface that provides the means for a system to be designed that supports a range of NAND Flash devices without direct design pre-association. The solution also provides the means for a system to seamlessly make use of new NAND devices that may not have existed at the time that the system was designed. ONFI 4.1 defines four data interfaces (asynchronous SDR, source-synchronous NV-DDR, NV-DDR2, and NV-DDR3) with data rates up to 1.2 GT/s, a unified command set (Read/Program/Erase/Read Status/Read ID/Read Parameter Page/Reset/Set Features/Get Features/ZQ Calibration), a 256-byte parameter page describing device geometry and capabilities, multi-LUN support per package, optional EZ NAND ECC offload, multi-plane operations, command/address/data latching via CLE/ALE/WE_n strobes (SDR) or CLK/WE_n (NV-DDR family), and on-die termination (ODT) for NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3.
external_pins: CE_n (Chip Enable, active-low; one per NAND Target unless CE_n pin reduction is used)
WE_n (Write Enable, SDR; shares pin with CLK on NV-DDR/NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3)
CLK (Clock, NV-DDR/NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3; shares pin with WE_n in SDR/NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3)
RE_n (Read Enable True; shares pin with W/R_n on NV-DDR/NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 / RE_t)
RE_c (Read Enable Complement; optional in NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 for differential signaling)
W/R_n (Write/Read Direction; NV-DDR; shares pin with RE_n)
CLE (Command Latch Enable)
ALE (Address Latch Enable)
WP_n (Write Protect, active-low; disables Program / Erase)
R/B_n (Ready/Busy, open-drain output; LOW = busy)
DQ[7:0] / IO[7:0] (bidirectional data bus, x8)
DQ[15:8] / IO[8:15] (upper byte; only for x16 SDR devices)
DQS (Data Strobe True, NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3; bidirectional)
DQS_c (Data Strobe Complement; optional NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 differential)
VccQ (I/O power; separate from core Vcc)
Vcc (core power)
Vss (ground)
VssQ (I/O ground)
VREFQ (NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 input reference voltage)
VDDi (ASIC internal-regulator stabilizing capacitor pin; EZ NAND only)
Vpp (optional high-voltage power; improves Program / Erase efficiency)
ZQ (ZQ calibration reference pin; tied to Vss through RZQ external resistor)
ENi / ENo (Enumeration input/output; CE_n pin reduction enumeration)
VSP (Vendor Specific pins)
package_options: BGA-100 (SDR x8, NV-DDR x8, NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 x8)
BGA-132 (SDR x8, NV-DDR x8, NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 x8)
BGA-152 (SDR x8, NV-DDR x8, NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 x8)
BGA-272 (quad 8-bit data access; SDR / NV-DDR / NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3)
BGA-316 (16 CE_n or 32 CE_n quad 8-bit data access; SDR / NV-DDR / NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3)
key_features: Four data interfaces in a single specification: SDR (asynchronous), NV-DDR (source-synchronous, up to 400 MT/s), NV-DDR2 (up to 800 MT/s), NV-DDR3 (up to 1.2 GT/s).

Common command set across all four data interfaces (Read 00h/30h, Page Program 80h/10h, Block Erase 60h/D0h, Read Status 70h, Read Status Enhanced 78h, Read ID 90h, Read Parameter Page ECh, Read Unique ID EDh, Set Features EFh, Get Features EEh, Reset FFh, Synchronous Reset FCh, Reset LUN FAh, ZQ Calibration Long F9h, ZQ Calibration Short D9h, Volume Select E1h, ODT Configure E2h).
Bus-cycle framing via CLE (command), ALE (address), WE_n (latch) for SDR; CLE + ALE + WE_n + CLK + DQS for NV-DDR family.
8-bit data bus (DQ[7:0]) on all interfaces; 16-bit (DQ[15:0]) data bus only on SDR-only packages.
Open-drain Ready/Busy (R/B_n) per LUN — low while any LUN operation is in progress; external pull-up required.
256-byte Parameter Page (read via ECh) self-describes device geometry, supported timing modes, ECC requirements, and feature support — no host-side hard-coded chip ID tables required.
Extended Parameter Page (signature 'EPPS') for additional Extended ECC Information when 256-byte page is insufficient.
16-byte Read Unique ID (read via EDh) with bit-wise complement for retrieval-error detection (XOR shall be all ones).
Multi-LUN: one or more independently-addressable Logical Units (LUNs) per NAND Target; each LUN has its own status register and may operate in parallel.
Multi-plane operations: Multi-plane Page Program (80h/11h chain), Multi-plane Block Erase (60h/D1h chain), Multi-plane Copyback Read and Program, Multi-plane Read.
Read Cache Random/Sequential (00h/31h) for pipelined random/sequential reads; Page Cache Program (80h/15h) for pipelined writes.
Copyback Read (00h/35h) + Copyback Program (85h/10h) for on-die copy without host data path.
EZ NAND option: NAND controller stacked in package offloads ECC and lithography-specific management; parameter page reports EZ NAND support.
ZQ Calibration (F9h Long after reset, D9h Short for V/T drift) using external RZQ reference resistor between ZQ pin and Vss for output driver impedance calibration in NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3.
On-Die Termination (ODT) for NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 with Selected / Deselected / Sniff states; self-termination and matrix termination modes; ODT Configure (E2h).
Volume Select (E1h) + ENi/ENo enumeration chain for CE_n pin reduction (multiple targets share one CE_n).
DCC (Duty Cycle Correction), Read DQ Training, Write TX DQ Training (Pattern 63h / Readback 64h), Write RX DQ Training (76h) for NV-DDR3 timing calibration.
Synchronous Reset (FCh) — exits NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 state without dropping the data interface; conventional Reset (FFh) drops back to SDR.
Independent Data Buses (Section 2.16) and dual data bus DQ_0 / DQ_1 (IO0_1..IO7_1) for higher per-package throughput.
Differential signaling (RE_t/RE_c, DQS_t/DQS_c, CLK with no complement) for NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 noise immunity.
Status register bit field: bit 7 WP_n / bit 6 RDY / bit 5 ARDY / bit 4 VSP / bit 3 CSP / bit 2 Reserved / bit 1 FAILC / bit 0 FAIL.
Staggered power-up support (Section 2.14) for systems with many targets sharing one power rail.
topology_summary: Single host (NAND controller) shared with one or more NAND Targets per CE_n. Each Target contains one or more LUNs (dies). Host drives CE_n / CLE / ALE / WE_n / RE_n / WP_n / DQ; device drives R/B_n (open-drain). NV-DDR family adds CLK (shared pin with WE_n) and DQS (bidirectional source-synchronous strobe). Up to four CE_n on a single package, or many more on BGA-272 / BGA-316 quad 8-bit access. CE_n pin reduction allows a Volume Address shared CE_n with per-target Volume Select.

data_interface_summary_table.latching_edge_data: rising edge of WE_n (write), RE_n falling (read)

revision_history.description: Initial ONFI release. Asynchronous SDR data interface only. 256-byte Parameter Page, basic command set (Read/Program/Erase/Reset/Set Features/Get Features/Read ID/Read Parameter Page).
Added source-synchronous NV-DDR data interface (up to 200 MT/s). Added DQS strobe, CLK pin sharing WE_n. Added Synchronous Reset (FCh).
Added Multi-plane operations, Read Cache Sequential / Random, Read Status Enhanced (78h).
NV-DDR extended to 200 MT/s. Editorial clarifications.
Added EZ NAND option (controller stacked in NAND package).
Added NV-DDR2 data interface (up to 533 MT/s). Differential DQS. On-Die Termination. ZQ Calibration. CE_n pin reduction with Volume Select (E1h).
NV-DDR2 timing modes extended to 800 MT/s. Extended Parameter Page signature 'EPPS'. Extended ECC Information.
Added NV-DDR3 data interface (up to 800 MT/s initially). Independent Data Buses. ODT Configure (E2h). Matrix termination.
NV-DDR3 timing modes extended to 1200 MT/s. Added DCC training, Read DQ Training, Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h) / Readback (64h), Write RX DQ Training (76h), Implicit DCC Training (18h).

use_cases: Solid-state drives (SSDs) — host SSD controller talks ONFI to multiple NAND packages in parallel.
USB flash drives and microSD / SD / eMMC card internal NAND.
Embedded MMC (eMMC) and Universal Flash Storage (UFS) NAND die.
Enterprise NVMe storage with multi-channel ONFI NAND backends.
Automotive and industrial bulk-storage SoCs (infotainment, dash-cam, drive recorder).
Networking equipment configuration storage (router boot-image, switch firmware).
overview: ONFI defines a standardized hardware interface to packaged NAND Flash devices. The specification covers (1) physical/electrical signaling for four interface families — asynchronous SDR plus three source-synchronous DDR families (NV-DDR up to 400 MT/s, NV-DDR2 up to 800 MT/s, NV-DDR3 up to 1.2 GT/s); (2) a unified command set transferred over the 8-bit DQ bus with CLE / ALE / WE_n latching (SDR) or CLK / WE_n latching (NV-DDR family); (3) a 256-byte Parameter Page (with optional Extended Parameter Page) that self-describes device geometry, ECC requirements, supported timing modes, and feature parameters; (4) per-LUN status register polling via Read Status (70h) and Read Status Enhanced (78h) plus the open-drain R/B_n pin; (5) multi-LUN, multi-plane, and CE_n pin reduction with Volume Select for high-density / many-die packages; (6) Set Features (EFh) / Get Features (EEh) for run-time configuration including timing mode, drive strength, ODT, training; (7) optional EZ NAND for NAND controllers stacked in the NAND package to offload ECC and lithography-specific management. The specification is jointly authored by Intel, Micron, Phison, Western Digital, SK Hynix, and Sony under the ONFI workgroup.
